meta.method: ROUGH ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE RANGE, NOT A COUNT. people = Orphanet prevalence-class bounds x population (worldwide 8.1 billion, Europe 750 million, US 335 million). Point prevalence is used when Orphanet has a usable class; otherwise prevalence at birth is used as a proxy (overestimates living patients when survival is reduced). A rate recorded for one area is applied to another only when that area has no record of its own (see rate_from). '<1 / 1 000 000' has lower bound 0; '>1 / 1000' has no upper bound. Classes 'Unknown' / 'Not yet documented', annual incidence and case counts are never converted to people.
